interface.source: problem.txt interface list; harness mandates TopModule

semantics.clock: All sequential logic triggered on positive edge, as stated in problem.txt.
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous reset sets q to zero at rising edge, regardless of slowena.
semantics.transition: At each rising edge: if reset, q=0; else if slowena, q=(q+1) modulo 10; else hold q.
semantics.visibility: New q is visible after the rising-edge sequential update; no extra latency.
semantics.initialization: No initial value is specified; no power-up initialization is added. Tests begin numerical checking after a reset edge.
semantics.between_edges: q holds despite changes to reset or slowena between positive edges.

numeric.wrap: 9 increments to 0; period is 10 enabled rising edges

verification.oracle: Independent integer count of enabled rising edges since last reset, modulo 10, grounded in original problem.txt.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs at falling edges; compare before rising edge and after NBA settling. Check stability at falling edges and on off-edge reset pulses.
verification.coverage: Reset with either enable value, all ten states, repeated wraps, pauses at every value, reset from every value, bursty enables, reset priority, reset pulses without rising edges.
verification.development_check: python3 dev_check.py --label initial; fatal mismatch, bounded timeout, explicit PASS marker

specification_ambiguities.evidence: The problem specifies synchronous reset but no initial state.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not impose a power-up value or compare q before first reset edge.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: The problem describes only decade counting and binary control behavior.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No additional recovery behavior or unknown-input requirements are imposed; verify reachable states after reset.
